what_happened.line: The commissioners reviewed two municipal attorney proposals and decided to keep looking for more candidates and to ask other water districts which attorney they use.
They agreed to call Stantec about the Mass Ave water main and the mapping work, and to consider proposals from other engineering firms.
Stantec had not responded about putting the Mass Ave water main out to bid, though money was appropriated at the annual meeting and funds become available July 1.
The only vote was approval of the April 28 minutes.
A sign question under the bylaw and a silting and culvert concern across the street were both left for follow-up.

why_it_matters: The Mass Ave water main was funded at the annual meeting, and a delay in getting it out to bid is a mechanism that could push back work on a service residents pay for through their water bills.
Both the legal counsel and the engineering firm are still open questions for the district, so who advises it on its contracts and projects may change.
watch_next: Whether Stantec responds and the Mass Ave water main goes out to bid once funds are available July 1.
Whether the commissioners choose a municipal attorney after reviewing the two proposals and hearing from other water districts.
